training.normalization: Training demonstrations only; shared split and statistics across stages
training.selection: EMA held-out velocity loss, four Monte Carlo draws

evaluation.execution: Replan every environment step; execute the first action
evaluation.success_definition: Environment task predicate true at any point within the episode
evaluation.paired_initial_observations: All 19 observation coordinates exactly equal for each seed
evaluation.expansion_rule: Evaluate five paired seeds, expand to twenty if at least three clean episodes succeed; all outcomes retained

blind.policy_inputs_after_warmup: Previous RSSM state and executed actions; no new observations

limits: One training seed and twenty paired evaluation seeds on one simulated task
Success at any point is not a sustained-hold or recovery guarantee
No independently validated Can, vision, latency, or matched baseline results in this release
Bundled repairs and research changes do not isolate the cause of historical failures
